lxc_bb9ca5dfc3f9a904.text: Alexey Pajitnov made Tetris in 1984 on an old Soviet computer with no pictures, only text.

lxc_94fac319533479de.text: Copies spread from Moscow, and the Nintendo Game Boy carried the game around the world.

lxc_d371926b6caa0966.text: Many famous games come from big companies.

lxc_710d3152e945eeeb.text: Moscow was the capital of the Soviet Union, a very large country that lasted from 1922 to 1991.

lxc_2c206f84349a2a37.text: Pajitnov worked at the Dorodnitsyn Computing Centre.

lxc_80c35d4df3b1ca62.text: This was a research place under the Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union.

lxc_f5868d956db34d1b.text: His main job was not games.

lxc_0fb8b8f4627b733b.text: But in his free time he liked puzzles.

lxc_1e2f971541b1f64d.text: That love of puzzles was the start of Tetris.

lxc_2454a38b28086437.text: In this story, we can follow three steps: the source, the change, and the result.

lxc_68bec1d74c627de7.text: The source was one man and his puzzles.

lxc_cbb3afea224009be.text: Pajitnov built the first Tetris on a machine called the Elektronika 60.

lxc_c9b9c7747a9460c4.text: It was made by a company named Elektronika in the city of Voronezh.

lxc_7c04929169e8a4b9.text: The company made this computer from 1978 to 1991.

lxc_700429903e532fd4.text: It sat in a rack, like a metal shelf.

lxc_e1b11cf33d2edd6d.text: It could not show pictures at all.

lxc_f42afb10d2216eea.text: So the first Tetris had no drawings.

lxc_3fea102afcab1ed4.text: The falling blocks were made from text characters, like letters and symbols on a page.

lxc_d4aae0ff7628b85b.text: A block was just a group of characters that moved down the screen.

lxc_8a9e7ceca1b190a0.text: This was a very simple look.

lxc_6238babe561eae6e.text: But the idea under it was strong.

lxc_e1eaef761e8fd1ba.text: The name Tetris has two parts.

lxc_9d02afba01d949e2.text: The first part comes from the word tetra.

lxc_c109e98220c3d283.text: Every Tetris piece is made of four small squares.

lxc_b25161a7711b8f44.text: The second part comes from tennis.

lxc_bf28e2ae71c1f532.text: Pajitnov liked tennis, so he joined the two words.

lxc_a45aec785e563934.text: The game itself is easy to explain.

lxc_2f7fef0c64a10e03.text: The player turns them and moves them.

lxc_8cd04a7397d997bb.text: A full line of squares disappears.

lxc_0b3f000c2f9f10dd.text: This mix is the heart of the game.

lxc_f7c53c52a738d5f9.text: Many people in Japan know this feeling from small puzzle games on a train ride.

lxc_504722050cc56a74.text: A short game fits a short trip.

lxc_c966903b7e9062e1.text: The idea from Moscow fits that life too.

lxc_23a1b467547d6027.text: The game did not stay in one office.

lxc_0b118e4751cd35b7.text: They copied it and gave it to friends.

lxc_af9f09c39b51171d.text: Copies moved from one computer to another.

lxc_aed279d19da73eef.text: Later, versions appeared on home computers.

lxc_388f6374bc3879a4.text: The game left the Soviet Union and reached other countries.

lxc_a2d124c28f595ed4.text: This spread was fast for the time.

lxc_7ff806e5611fca0d.text: It happened with no big advertising.

lxc_096eb3b129de55e2.text: The reason was the game itself.

lxc_d3ebf4d13082033c.text: It was easy to learn in one minute.

lxc_3a3f22a8cd8c5557.text: One copy made ten more copies.

lxc_e7b739b100af8438.text: In the lens of source, change, and result, this is the change.

lxc_a9752366511b01a2.text: A small puzzle from a research centre was now a game in many homes.

lxc_c3c91afa960ad38f.text: The result came with a small machine.

lxc_e4991f10dafdd4aa.text: Nintendo is a Japanese video game company.

lxc_b61fe5b0ac023022.text: In 1989 Nintendo released a handheld console called the Game Boy.

lxc_aab5642adb60ef50.text: A handheld console is a game machine you hold in your hands.

lxc_abe5eca7ebc3e374.text: Nintendo also released Tetris for the Game Boy.

lxc_6da59507b8bfc35e.text: People could now play Tetris on a bus, at school, or at home.

lxc_4fa1e8e42eb06083.text: The small screen and the small game were a perfect match.

lxc_367672ef56827477.text: Tetris on the Game Boy helped the game become huge around the world.

lxc_481eb803e4dffbda.text: So the story ends far from its start.

lxc_c887c3c64a97f201.text: The source was a text-only computer in Moscow.

lxc_ffabbfd52e66704c.text: The result was a game in millions of pockets, made famous by a company from Japan.
